001.description: Blister packaging surcharge for ALLER-20 monthly production
001.gap: The packaging authorization identifying blister packaging for this billed order is unverified.
001.claim: Bottle packaging is included in unit production pricing; other packaging formats require a purchase order or written change authorization identifying the format.

002.description: Batch manufacturing and QA release fee for lot NS-1026-02
002.gap: Sponsor QA release status for the billed batch is unverified.
002.claim: Pending batches are not billable for batch manufacturing, QA release, or line clearance fees.

003.description: Premium freight surcharge for an EU lane shipment
003.gap: A purchase order identifying the shipment and approved lane exception is unverified.
003.claim: Standard outbound logistics in approved EU lanes are included in cartoning pricing; premium logistics require a purchase order identifying the shipment and approved lane exception.

004.gap: Actual released lot yield and any applicable sponsor-approved campaign reservation clause are unverified.
004.claim: Quarterly yield true-ups use actual released lot yield rather than forecast yield; unreleased or failed yield is not billable unless a sponsor-approved campaign reservation clause applies.

005.gap: The completed pull date and approved study or deviation window are unverified.
005.claim: Stability pulls are billable within the study schedule or a sponsor-approved deviation window; early pulls and handling-error replacement pulls are not separately billable.

006.description: Changeover fee between ALLER-CAP 25 mg and ALLER-CAP 50 mg
006.gap: Campaign records establishing the billed changeover timing are unverified.
006.claim: Same-family capsule strength changeovers in the same campaign week are included in unit pricing; different product-family or active-ingredient changeovers can be billable.

007.gap: Occupied pallet days, the study close notice, and any written storage extension are unverified.
007.claim: Storage is billable by occupied pallet day through the study close date; storage after close requires a written extension identifying the protocol and storage end date.

008.gap: The customs entry, broker-of-record status, and master and child shipment billing records are unverified.
008.claim: Customs brokerage is billable once per shipment when Valence is broker of record; both master and child records cannot be billed for the same customs entry.

009.gap: The deviation record establishing cause and any sponsor quality approval are unverified.
009.claim: Supplier-process-error contamination or deviation investigation, cleaning, and restart costs are not billable; sponsor-material-caused charges require sponsor quality approval.

010.gap: The monthly scrap record and evidence of sponsor-caused defect or sponsor-approved process change are unverified.
010.claim: Unit assembly pricing includes component scrap up to 1.5%; excess scrap requires a record showing sponsor-caused component defect or sponsor-approved process change.

011.gap: Release packet completeness and sponsor QA acceptance of sterilization documentation are unverified.
011.claim: Release packet fees require a complete packet and sponsor QA acceptance; draft, incomplete, or rejected packets are not billable as final packets.

012.gap: The approved protocol classification and sponsor QA acceptance of the executed batch record are unverified.
012.claim: Engineering batches use the engineering rate; GMP validation billing requires an approved protocol identifying the batch as GMP validation and sponsor QA acceptance of its executed record.

013.gap: The contract unit cost on the purchase order date, applied escalation rate, and any written pre-shipment procurement approval are unverified.
013.claim: Lot pricing uses the contract unit cost on the purchase order date; annual escalation is capped at 2.5% unless written procurement lead approval precedes shipment.

014.gap: Actual released volume and the applicable forecast version for the billed month and SKU are unverified.
014.claim: Volume true-ups compare forecast and actual released volume for the same month and SKU; an old forecast cannot replace an updated forecast issued before production.

015.gap: The approved regulatory work order country scope and any pre-work added-country approval are unverified.
015.claim: Submission fees require country coverage in the approved regulatory work order; added countries require sponsor regulatory approval before work begins.

policy_claims.invoice-reconciliation-policy.md#4-minim: The policy requires an authorized source document linking the billed item to its supplier, product, batch, milestone, material, capacity period, or shipment.
policy_claims.invoice-reconciliation-policy.md#2-requi: The policy lists applicable contracts, pricing, purchase orders, receipts, batch and quality records, milestone acceptance, materials, and capacity records as reconciliation evidence.
policy_claims.invoice-reconciliation-policy.md#5-payme: The policy lists duplicate billing, off-contract fees, rate and volume errors, missed discounts, invalid true-ups, early milestones, unreleased batches, and unsupported pass-through charges as leakage categories.
policy_claims.quality-release-billability-policy.md#3-: The policy excludes pending batches from completed production, release testing, and release administration billing until release or a contract-defined milestone.
policy_claims.quality-release-billability-policy.md#6-: Quality invoice evidence includes applicable batch identity, release status and date, agreement sections, test and deviation records, or sponsor approval.
policy_claims.invoice-dispute-and-recovery-procedure.m: The procedure describes a dispute packet containing supplier and invoice identity, disputed amount, contract or policy basis, operational evidence, and supplier action context.
The procedure describes evidence-backed supplier communications identifying the invoice line, controlling terms, variance, and correction or documentation context.
The procedure permits withholding disputed amounts while undisputed amounts follow payment terms and sets weekly review of withheld amounts.
The procedure lists repeated supplier behavior, quality status conflicts, sensitive product information, IP-sensitive terms, and potential compliance impact as escalation triggers.

new_document_cases.question: Retrieve Aster Ridge's unit production pricing terms. Explain how monthly volume changes the price basis and which units a volume adjustment applies to.
new_document_cases.claim: The base price is USD 0.42 per released tablet up to 3,000,000 monthly released tablets; a 6% discount applies only to units above that threshold.

new_document_cases.question: Retrieve HelioPack's serialized-unit billing terms. Explain the count basis and how final inspection status affects billable units.
new_document_cases.claim: Serialized-unit fees use the lesser of commissioned serial numbers and sponsor shipment receipts; final-inspection rejects are not billable as accepted serialized units.

new_document_cases.question: Retrieve Evergreen's rush-order terms. Identify the required authorization details and explain whether supplier schedule recovery has the same billing basis.
new_document_cases.claim: Rush-order authorization identifies the lot, requested ship date, and rush service level; supplier-initiated schedule recovery is not billable as a rush order.

new_document_cases.question: Retrieve Atlas's regional production price tiers. Explain the price basis when released monthly volume reaches a tier and whether it covers all units or only incremental units.
new_document_cases.claim: Below 2,000,000 monthly released tablets the price is USD 0.39; at 2,000,000 or more it is USD 0.36 for all released units in that month.

new_document_cases.question: Retrieve Signal Ridge's authority-response milestone terms. Identify the evidence needed to establish a milestone trigger, without treating a document draft as proof of completion.
new_document_cases.claim: Authority-response milestone billing requires receipt of an acknowledgement or deficiency letter and sponsor acceptance of the response package for that authority interaction.
